name: Theme icons
description: Material file and folder icons with a configurable GTK icon theme for desktop controls.

fields.title: Icon theme name
fields.description: Installed theme directory name, for example Adwaita. Missing themes fall back to the session icon theme.

fields.title: Use the session icon theme
fields.description: Use the icon theme that was active before this extension started.

fields.title: Material file and folder icons
fields.description: Use bundled Material Icon Theme icons in Files, Quick Open and Editor tabs.
